comments.author: jamesxiang11
comments.body_html: How do you safely uninstall those mods? Cant click on the bars on top like skills, quests, etc.

comments.author: IHateChoosing
comments.body_html:
put the mods back into user/mods.
Then go into the game, choose one of the normal outfits.
Shove some stuff around the inventory, buy or sell smth so your profile is saved.
Close the game.

Remove the mods.
Go into your profile, and delete the entries in “suits”: that are related to these mods.
That would be
JWGROMUPPERBODYSUIT
JWGROMPANTSSUIT

PARARESCUEUPPERBODYSUIT
etc.
Depending on which outfits you bought.

It goes without saying that you should also make sure not to have any of the items in your inventory left before removing (the actual rig/ helmet etc).
